title: Mon portrait
author: Александр Пушкин
text:
Vous me demandez mon portrait,
Mais peint d'aprs nature;
Mon cher, il sera bientt fait,
Quoique en miniature.
translation:
You ask me for my portrait,
But painted from nature;
My dear, it will soon be done,
Though in miniature.

title: Mon portrait
author: Александр Пушкин
text:
Je suis un jeune polisson,
Encore dans les classes;
Point sot, je le dis sans faon
Et sans fades grimaces.
translation:
I am a young scamp,
Still in the classes;
Not foolish, I say without fuss
And without insipid grimaces.

title: Mon portrait
author: Александр Пушкин
text:
Onc il ne fut de babillard,
Ni docteur en Sorbonne
Plus ennuyeux et plus braillard,
Que moi-mme en personne.
translation:
Never was there a chatterbox,
Nor a Sorbonne doctor
More boring and more noisy,
Than myself in person.

title: Mon portrait
author: Александр Пушкин
text:
Ma taille  celles des plus longs
Ne peut tre gale;
J'ai le teint frais, les cheveux blonds
Et la tte boucle.
translation:
My height cannot be compared
To that of the tallest;
I have a fresh complexion, blond hair
And a curly head.

title: Mon portrait
author: Александр Пушкин
text:
J'aime et le monde et son fracas,
Je hais la solitude;
J'abhorre et noises, et dbats,
Et tant soit peu l'tude.
translation:
I love the world and its uproar,
I hate solitude;
I abhor both quarrels and disputes,
And study ever so little.

title: Mon portrait
author: Александр Пушкин
text:
Spectacles, bals me plaisent fort,
Et d'aprs ma pense,
Je dirais ce que j'aime encor...
Si n'tais au Lyce.
translation:
Shows, balls please me greatly,
And according to my thought,
I would say what else I love...
If I were not at the Lyceum.

title: Mon portrait
author: Александр Пушкин
text:
Aprs cel, mon cher ami,
L'on peut me reconnatre:
Oui! tel que le bon Dieu me fit,
Je veux toujours paratre.
translation:
After this, my dear friend,
One can recognize me:
Yes! Such as the good Lord made me,
I always wish to appear.

title: Mon portrait
author: Александр Пушкин
text:
Vrai dmon pour l'espiglerie,
Vrai singe par sa mine,
Beaucoup et trop d'tourderie.
Ma foi, voil Pouchkine.
translation:
A true demon for mischief,
A true monkey in his face,
Much and too much heedlessness.
My faith, here is Pushkin.
